25. LSP — Liskov Substitution
Principle

SIMPLE ENGLISH
A subtype must honor the behavioral contract of its supertype so clients can substitute it
without breaking expected properties.
සිංහJලෙන් Parent type එක Jවනුවට child type එකක් දුම්මතේ කලින් JපාJරාන්දු වූ behavior එක කුJඩන්න
බුහු. Interface එJක් methods තිJයන එක විතරක් ප්‍රමාණවතේ නුහු.
A read-only repository must not pretend to support a write contract that promises saving.

Q: What is an LSP violation?
A: A subtype strengthens preconditions or weakens promised outcomes, causing valid client
usage to fail.
